newsitem.title: USA: Duff & Phelps rates Conseco commercial paper D-2.
newsitem.headline: Duff & Phelps rates Conseco commercial paper D-2.

text.p: Duff & Phelps Credit Rating Co said Wednesday it has rated Conseco Inc's $1.4 billion commercial paper program at D-2.
The commercial paper program is backed by a $1.4 billion unsecured revolving credit facility, Duff & Phelps said.
The company's senior debt is rated Triple-B. Duff & Phelps put Conseco's senior debt on a rating watch for a possible upgrade following Conseco's agreement to acquire Pioneer Financial Services Inc.
Duff & Phelps said it expects the deal with Pioneer and a merger with Capitol American Financial Corp to close within the first six months of 1997.

"Upon completion, DCR expects Conseco's senior debt rating to be upgraded to Triple-B-Plus and Conseco-related senior subordinated debt ratings to be upgraded to Triple-B," Duff & Phelps said in a statement.
